style_01_aggressive_youtube_cold_start.label: Aggressive YouTube Cold Start
use_when: YouTube Shorts or similar cold traffic
the first seconds must create a strong reason to keep watching
the source has visible conflict, danger, confession, reversal, choice, consequence, or object clues
avoid: repeated same-framing close-ups without emotional purpose

script_rules.opening: start with a source-supported conflict, danger, contradiction, confession, or clear question in the first 1-2 seconds
script_rules.middle: add supported micro-hooks every 6-10 seconds and pay off or escalate each within 6-15 seconds
script_rules.ending: end at the strongest retention point; do not require full episode closure
script_rules.support: use only visible action, dialogue, emotion, objects, and transcript/frame-supported relationships

shot_mapping_rules.cold_open: may use up to 5 seconds of fast cuts and at most 2 documented nonlinear exceptions
shot_mapping_rules.return_to_main_path: return to the main source timeline within 6-8 seconds
shot_mapping_rules.body: use 3-6 contiguous source blocks for a 60-second short
shot_mapping_rules.unit_binding: bind each script unit to one small source block or adjacent block pair
shot_mapping_rules.replacement: prefer the nearest later suitable shot in the same story beat
shot_mapping_rules.large_jumps: allow only at beat or paragraph transitions with recorded reasons

style_02_natural_plot_explanation.label: Natural Plot Explanation
use_when: the user asks for a calmer recap, chronological explanation, or lower-risk continuity
the source is dialogue-heavy or emotionally quiet
retention should come from clarity and plot causality rather than nonlinear shock

script_rules.opening: start with a clear source-supported question or situation, not empty sensationalism
script_rules.middle: keep events chronological and explain cause-effect relationships compactly
script_rules.ending: end at a clear emotional or plot turning point

shot_mapping_rules.cold_open: chronological source opening or a light same-block hook only
shot_mapping_rules.return_to_main_path: nonlinear returns should be unnecessary; if present, user approval is required
shot_mapping_rules.body: use 3-5 contiguous source blocks for a 60-second recap
shot_mapping_rules.unit_binding: bind each script unit to one source block or adjacent pair
shot_mapping_rules.replacement: prefer nearest later suitable shot in the same story beat
shot_mapping_rules.large_jumps: allow only when a new plot beat begins and reason is recorded

style_03_emotional_reversal.label: Emotional Reversal
use_when: the episode has a clear emotional turn, confession, betrayal, reconciliation, or relationship reveal
the edit should preserve facial reactions and pauses
the user wants impact from emotion rather than maximum cuts
avoid: explaining feelings not supported by source

script_rules.opening: open with the emotional contradiction or relationship question
script_rules.middle: let reactions breathe and pay off emotional clues within 8-18 seconds
script_rules.ending: end on the strongest emotional reversal or unresolved relationship question
script_rules.support: do not state inner psychology unless dialogue, expression, or action supports it

shot_mapping_rules.cold_open: may use one reviewed emotional teaser
shot_mapping_rules.return_to_main_path: return to the main timeline within 8 seconds when a teaser is used
shot_mapping_rules.replacement: replace with same-character or same-relationship reaction when possible
shot_mapping_rules.large_jumps: allow only at emotional beat transitions

style_04_action_battle_escalation.label: Action Battle Escalation
use_when: the source has visible action, danger, impact, chase, or battle escalation
the edit should feel energetic while keeping source support auditable
motion and consequence are more important than dialogue continuity

script_rules.opening: open with visible danger, impact, or consequence
script_rules.middle: escalate action beats and pay off the consequence of each threat
script_rules.ending: end at the strongest impact, reversal, or unresolved danger
script_rules.support: state only action outcomes visible in the source or dialogue-supported

shot_mapping_rules.cold_open: may use fast source-supported impact cuts for up to 5 seconds
shot_mapping_rules.return_to_main_path: return to main source timeline within 8 seconds
shot_mapping_rules.body: use 3-6 contiguous action blocks, not scattered highlight sampling
shot_mapping_rules.unit_binding: bind threat, action, impact, and reaction as adjacent source windows
shot_mapping_rules.large_jumps: allow only between action phases with reason recorded
